title: Recording: Have You Seen A Horizon Lately? by Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono

Yoko Ono worked on ‘Have You Seen A Horizon Lately?’ for her third album Approximately Infinite Universe on 2 November 1972, with John Lennon co-producing.

The song was re-recorded on 6 November, and mixed on 19 and 22 November.
